base.interpretation: Fractions use the metric-index mapping exported in the trace metadata; summed weights are not reported as raw CPU cycles.

pgo.interpretation: Fractions use the metric-index mapping exported in the trace metadata; summed weights are not reported as raw CPU cycles.

limitations: Three alternating trials per variant on a shared host; ranges overlap; not a confidence interval.
Stock forward PLAY only; diagnostic positions are firmware-specific; retained-position PAUSE is not separately classified.
Playing detector observes chunk boundaries, at most 2048 packets; GIE is a post-packet background proxy.
Hardware counters are one separate 5-second recording per variant, user level, first playback window, excluded from throughput medians.
Instruction-delivery category is broader than L1 instruction-cache misses; no isolated I-cache miss-rate claim.
No AOT-local caching or native machine-code backend was implemented in this live compiler experiment.
